system.description:
Effect: Creates an immediate-radius explosion of sticky goo up to a short distance away. Make separate Speed attacks against each creature in the area. Success means they are held in place. The goo lasts until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery but can be cut, broken, or burned (inflicting 4 damage from fire to anyone held in it). NPCs can break free as an action (you can prevent this by making a Speed roll against them).

Genre Items: scroll of web (fantasy); restraint grenade (sci-fi) Rather than strands of sticky goo, some adhesion bombs fill the area with quick￾hardening foam, constricting vines, spectral tentacles, or similar effects with the same result.
